description:
Ready to find the mythical creature that matches your vibe?

Answer a few simple questions and enjoy a casual personality quiz that points you toward one of 16 fantasy-inspired types.

You know those little choices that somehow feel very you? This game turns that feeling into a light, easy-to-read result based on the answers you pick.

How to play is simple!

・Read the question
・Choose the answer that feels closest to you
・Check your result

There are no right or wrong answers, so just go with your gut and have fun seeing what type appears.

Play solo and read your result at your own pace, or try it with family and friends to compare everyone’s types.

Recommended for players who like personality quizzes, fantasy themes, quick casual games, or a fun conversation starter.

What kind of mythical creature is sleeping inside you?
Answer by instinct and discover your type from the 16 possibilities!

Button and touch controls are supported.
